*   [Vorssaint](https://vorssaint.com) - Open-source menu bar toolkit for per-app volume, system monitoring, window control, clipboard history, keeping awake, and app cleanup. items.title: Awesome Godot
items.content_text:
### Plugins and scripts / Godot 4

*   [Juicee (⭐42)](https://github.com/Kelpekk/Juicee) - game-feel effects (screen shake, hit stop, camera effects and more) with a visual graph editor, inspector UI, and one-liner API. Inspired by Unity's FEEL.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [Ralph Harness (⭐5)](https://github.com/rxdt/py_ralph_frame) - Tiny Python scaffold for running Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and similar coding agents in guarded local loops. It uses repo-local specs, fresh-context iterations, hard caps, git-hook gates, CI verification, and coverage gates.
